Operating System: Android 13, Realme UI T
Resolution: 720 x 1600px
Available Capacities: (64GB + 3GB of RAM) (128GB + 4GB of RAM) (256GB + 4GB of RAM)
Memory card: microSD (dedicated slot)
Network Technology: GSM / HSPA / LTE
The Realme Note 60 is the new entry-level phone from the Chinese company. It arrived on the market in January 2024 with simple specifications and a focus on those looking for a more affordable smartphone. The device's technical specifications include the Unisoc Tiger T612 chipset, and it comes with A combination of 4GB of RAM and 64GB of internal storage. 

The camera setup is also basic and consists of two rear sensors, a main 13 MP sensor assisted by a 0.08 MP monochrome sensor. For selfies, it has a 5 MP camera. 

For the screen, it features a 6.74-inch IPS LCD panel with an HD+ resolution of 1600 x 720 pixels and a 90 Hz refresh rate. Other features include support for 4G network only, Wi-Fi 5 Dual Band, Bluetooth 5.0, side fingerprint reader, and a 3.5mm headphone jack.

The battery has A capacity of 5,000 mAh with charging of only 10 W. uu

We look forward to your order and happy shopping!
